description: A mix of illness and injuries have hit the Blue Jays hard as the defending American League champions have struggled to maintain a winning record in the early days of the new season.
title: Blue Jays players hit by nasty bug as they struggle through early season

description: In Scotland, where both golf and curling originated around the 16th century, the sports go hand in hand — and similarities from strategy to sportsmanship to tradition abound.
title: Curling and golf’s kinship on display as Rock League meets Masters

description: A lot's changed since the 2024 U.S. federal election that saw President Donald Trump return to the White House. CBC's Katie Simpson explains how some of Trump's most vocal supporters — right-wing influencers and public figures —
title: MAGA influencers are fed up with Trump

description: Prime Minister Mark Carney speaks with Artemis II's Canadian mission specialist Jeremy Hansen during the third and final space-to-Earth connection hosted by the Canadian Space Agency. Hansen and his three American crewmates are on their way back to Earth after completing a historic lunar flyby. (Credit: Canadian Space Agency/YouTube)
title: Carney speaks with Artemis II astronaut Jeremy Hansen

description: During his brief and ill-fated time as leader of the Liberal Party, Michael Ignatieff invited Canadians to join him inside the "big red tent." This appeal obviously did not work out for Ignatieff. But perhaps he was merely ahead of his time.
title: Carney’s Liberals are attracting support from unlikely places

description: A Pakistani citizen who lived on a study permit in the Greater Toronto Area has pleaded guilty in a U.S. federal court of attempting to commit an act of terrorism transcending national boundaries.
title: Former Ontario student pleads guilty in U.S. terrorism case

description: A company accused of producing bogus maple syrup is now the target of a class-action lawsuit request that has been filed in Quebec Superior Court.
title: Class-action lawsuit targets Quebec company accused of producing bogus maple syrup

description: Prosecutors are seeking Tiger Woods' prescription drug records from a pharmacy, a week after his vehicle crashed in Florida and he was arrested on suspicion of driving under the influence.
title: Prosecutors move to subpoena Tiger Woods' prescription drug records after Florida DUI arrest

description: The Testaments, an adaptation of Margaret Atwood's book, is releasing its first three episodes on Disney+ today and looking to expand on the chillingly regressive future predicted in The Handmaid's Tale. Its stars and creators talk to CBC News about the message and intent of the series.
title: Stars and producers of The Testaments feel the show's message is relevant 'because of Margaret's vision'

description: Ruby Penney went to the RCMP on Dec. 2, 2016, and told them about a strange phone call she overheard between Jennifer Hillier-Penney and her cousin Derick Hillier. Ruby Penney is not alive to testify, and Derick Hillier is not alive to defend himself.
title: Dean Penney's mother pointed to another suspect 1 day after Jennifer Hillier-Penney disappeared

description: Deputy minister of national defence Christiane Fox broke conflict of interest rules by hiring an old acquaintance when she was the deputy immigration minister, the federal ethics watchdog has found.
title: Deputy minister broke rules by hiring unqualified acquaintance: ethics watchdog

description: The announcement of a ceasefire between Iran and the United States was met in Lebanon with the war’s bloodiest day, as Israel launched a massive air campaign that its media termed "Operation Eternal Darkness." The Israeli strikes killed and wounded hundreds, as Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu signaled his intent to pursue Hezbollah regardless of international pressure.
title: With aggressive new attacks on Lebanon, Israel signals it will not be bound by Donald Trump’s ceasefire

description: A federal judge on Wednesday handed down a sentence of 15 years in prison to a woman who pleaded guilty to selling Friends star Matthew Perry the ketamine that killed him in 2023.
title: Judge gives 15-year sentence to woman who admitted selling Friends star Matthew Perry ketamine

description: Marie-louise Felicia Allen claimed in B.C. Supreme Court that her injured miniature pony was under veterinary care when the B.C. SPCA seized and destroyed it, arguing in her lawsuit that the actions were a violation of her Charter rights.
title: Judge tosses Charter challenge filed by woman whose pony was seized by B.C. SPCA

description: Heather Winterstein didn't show hallmark warning signs of potentially life-threatening sepsis when she went through triage screening the day before she died at the hospital in St. Catharines, Ont., an emergency medical expert told the coroner’s inquest for the 24-year-old.
title: Medical expert defends doctor’s assessment of woman before she died of sepsis in Ontario hospital

description: Ontario passed Bill 5, which included the special economic zone provision, last year in a bid to speed up approval and construction of large projects like mines. The provision allows cabinet and the environment minister to suspend any and all provincial and municipal laws within such zones as they see fit.
title: Ontario government's 'special economic zones' law facing constitutional challenge

description: The two actors appeared alongside each other in the 2020 film Black Bear and shared the stage in 2023 in the off-Broadway revival of Danny and the Deep Blue Sea.
title: Aubrey Plaza reportedly expecting her 1st child with Girls alum Chris Abbott

description: A Manhattan-based architect who led a secret life as a serial killer pleaded guilty on Wednesday to murdering seven women and admitted to killing an eighth in a string of long-unsolved crimes known as the Gilgo Beach killings.
title: Rex Heuermann admits to killing 8 women in New York state

description: A wave of Israeli airstrikes swept across Lebanon on Wednesday, leaving dozens dead and hundreds wounded, according to the Lebanese Health Ministry.
title: Israel escalates Lebanon campaign amid disputed U.S.-Iran ceasefire

description: Alex Ovechkin says he is waiting until after the Washington Capitals' season is over to decide whether he's calling it a career or returning to play one more year.
title: Alex Ovechkin to decide NHL future after season, with health biggest factor

description: An Alberta clipper brought heavy snow to central and southern areas of the province late Tuesday and into Wednesday.
title: Alberta clipper brings spring snowstorm to southern Manitoba, closes several schools

description: The ongoing war between Iran and the U.S. is expected to keep oil prices high for the remainder of the year, including gasoline, diesel and jet fuel prices too.
title: Oil and fuel prices to remain high throughout the year: Deloitte report

description: After a two-month investigation into significant alcohol thefts from NSLC stores in the Halifax region, RCMP seized more than 450 bottles of hard alcohol worth almost $20,000 from a home. Police even seized a ledger detailing the alcohol being delivered to the home and what had been resold.
title: $20K worth of alleged stolen booze in a single home: We tracked how N.S. liquor store theft is on the rise

description: One woman was admitted with a life-threatening condition called exercise-induced or exertional rhabdomyolysis, rhabdo for short. The illness can happen after an intense workout and is when muscle tissue breaks down, leaking enzymes and proteins into the bloodstream. In high amounts, the proteins can damage the kidneys and lead to an imbalance of electrolytes, which can cause dehydration and heart issues.
title: A workout class sent this St. John's woman to hospital. She's not the only one

description: Canada's army is weighing faster timelines for new armoured vehicles while rethinking tanks in light of Ukraine's drone-dominated battlefield. Aging Leopards need replacement, but commanders say technology — including uncrewed systems — will shape decisions, even as other priorities like air defence and long-range strike rank higher.
title: As drones upend tank warfare, Canada's army races to rethink its armour

description: Police raided a Montreal mattress company and found stolen cars. A CBC investigation into the city's car export industry found numerous Montreal businesses have sent stolen cars overseas.
title: CBC investigation finds numerous Montreal exporters sent stolen vehicles overseas

description: In China, the energy landscape has reached a historic tipping point. For the first time, its total installed wind and solar capacity has officially surpassed that of coal. It’s a shift driven by massive industrial scale and artificial intelligence — and Chinese energy giants have their sights set on the Canadian wilderness.
title: From the Gobi Desert to Canada’s North: This Chinese visionary is betting on AI to power this country’s future

description: As Eric Kripke's superhero satire The Boys releases the first two episodes of its fifth and final season today (with the last dropping on May 20), he's just glad to be able to say the show is ending on his terms.
title: The Boys' showrunner says it was a tough call to end the series. 'Politically, I have a lot more to say'

description: A 14-year-old aspiring soccer player living in Quebec has been given the opportunity of a lifetime. But his status as an asylum seeker is preventing him from getting on a plane and capitalizing on it.
title: This teen soccer prodigy is stuck in Quebec with invitation to Real Madrid training camp

description: Three second-period goals spurred the Montreal Victoire to a 4-1 win over the Seattle Torrent on Tuesday night in Laval, Que.
title: First-place Victoire make PWHL history with 10th home win of season

description: The B.C. Wildfire Service responded to the wildfire burning east of Pemberton Regional Airport in Mount Currie, which is part of Líl̓wat Nation.
title: ‘It's really dry’: Wildfire sparks in Líl̓wat Nation hay field near Pemberton, B.C., airport
